mechanism_narrative: A sustained near-zero federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% MoM and unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.2pp signal an overheating labor market, prompting anticipated monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions defined by housing starts above 900k units and retail sales growth above 0.8% MoM, overvaluation concerns drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Negative industrial production growth (INDPRO MoM < 0) signals economic weakness, prompting market anticipation of stimulus and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO MoM < 0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 800k units signal a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with HOUST < 800, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% signals weak economic activity and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth below 0.3% MoM signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with RSAFS MoM < 0.3%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
